newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton output reaches 7.366 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton output reaches 7.366 mln bales.

text.p: Pakistan's cotton output reached 7.366 million 375-lb bales by January 1 in the 1996/97 (July-June) crop year, compared to 7.547 million in the year-ago period, the Pakistan Cotton Ginners Association said on Sunday.
Aijazuddin Ghauri, secretary of the association, said production had fallen 2.39 percent compared to last season.

He said textile mills had bought 5.499 million bales, compared to 5.217 million a year earlier, while exporters had bought only 3,900 bales against 626,000. The balance of 1.863 million bales was lying unsold at ginning factories.
Government officials estimate that 1996/97 output will reach 9.2 to 9.5 million bales, down from 9.94 million bales in 1995/96. Dealers put this year's crop as low as 8.5 million bales.
